sources.title: PostgreSQL transaction isolation
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: 交易 outbox：資料提交與事件送達的分界
related.titleEn: Transactional outbox: database commit versus event delivery
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：讓兩個編輯者用同一版資料提交，僅允許第一個更新成功。 驗收紀錄必須包含通過/失敗、重現方式和剩餘限制；只對已檢查的模型範圍作結論。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Have two editors submit from the same version and allow only the first update to succeed. Acceptance includes pass/fail,reproduction instructions and remaining limits; conclusions stay within the checked model.
related.difference: 把訂單和待發事件同交易寫入，再用可重播 dispatcher 避免提交與傳送間遺失。
related.differenceEn: Write an order and pending event atomically,then use a replayable dispatcher to avoid gaps between commit and send.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: UPDATE ... WHERE id=? AND version=? 把讀過的版本當成前置條件；影響列數為零代表需重新讀取。 教學基準：8-2 = 6 first accepted stock；第二檢核：3+1 = 4 first accepted version。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。
Outbox 解決資料庫更新與發送意圖的原子性；接收端仍需去重，不能宣稱外部副作用自動 exactly-once。 教學基準：1+2+1 = 4 delivery attempts after replay；第二檢核：3 = 3 unique applied events。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: UPDATE with id and version predicates makes the read version a precondition; zero affected rows requires rereading. Teaching baseline: 8-2 = 6 first accepted stock; second check: 3+1 = 4 first accepted version. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.

Outbox atomically records data and send intent; receivers still need deduplication and external side effects are not automatically exactly-once. Teaching baseline: 1+2+1 = 4 delivery attempts after replay; second check: 3 = 3 unique applied events. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: LSM-tree：寫入放大與 compaction 合併
related.titleEn: LSM trees: write amplification and compaction merges
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：讓兩個編輯者用同一版資料提交，僅允許第一個更新成功。 驗收紀錄必須包含通過/失敗、重現方式和剩餘限制；只對已檢查的模型範圍作結論。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Have two editors submit from the same version and allow only the first update to succeed. Acceptance includes pass/fail,reproduction instructions and remaining limits; conclusions stay within the checked model.
related.difference: 追蹤同一 key 跨 SSTable 的版本，合併時只保留符合快照政策的最新值。
related.differenceEn: Trace key versions across SSTables and merge according to snapshot retention policy.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.

LSM 以批次有序檔降低隨機寫入，後續 compaction 會重寫資料；tombstone 刪除也有保存條件。 教學基準：100*3+200+300 = 800 physical MiB written；第二檢核：800/300 = 2.666666667 write amplification。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。

Teaching baseline: 100*3+200+300 = 800 physical MiB written; second check: 800/300 = 2.666666667 write amplification. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries.
